The '''Cmaoli Di system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cmaoli Di/Legends|Cmaoli Di]].
